THIS NOTICE IS IMPORTANT AND REQUIRES THE IMMEDIATE ATTENTION OF THE HOLDERS OF THE ETP SECURITIES. IF ANY ETP SECURITYHOLDER IS IN ANY DOUBT AS TO THE ACTION THEY SHOULD TAKE, THEY SHOULD CONSULT THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT PROFESSIONAL ADVISERS IMMEDIATELY

If you have recently sold or otherwise transferred your entire holding(s) of ETP Securities referred to below, you should immediately forward this document to the purchaser or transferee or to the stockbroker, bank or other agent through whom the sale or transfer was effected for transmission to the purchaser or transferee.
Notice to ETP Securityholders of Leverage Shares 3x Long Anthropic ETP (ISIN: XS3556798455) (the “Relevant Series”)

Leverage Shares plc (the “Issuer”) hereby announces that, following the conclusion of the Opening Auction of the Underlying Entity Shares of Anthropic, PBC (the “Underlying Entity”) on 19 November 2026 on Nasdaq Global Select Market, the Portfolio Administrator has acquired 30,260 Underlying Entity Shares on behalf of the Relevant Series at an average price of USD 111.83448 per Underlying Entity Share (the “Execution Price”).

Capitalised terms used, but not defined, in this notice shall have the meaning given thereto in the Issuer’s Base Prospectus as approved by the Financial Conduct Authority on 2 November 2026 and by the Central Bank of Ireland on 17 November 2026.
If you have any queries arising from this notice, please contact us at info@leverageshares.com.
